notes.purpose: G72-2 length-coverage wave: fills the 8K/16K hole (K=8 at depth 1 — the small-K axis the v3 grid lacked) and adds 64K (K=20 at depth 2). 32K/128K stay in the frozen p71 baseline; the union is composed at arm/export level, not by merging bank dirs.
notes.coverage_target: >=300 rows per length bucket; 8K and 16K via depth-1 cells, 64K via depth-2 cells; expected rows = (7 families x ~40 worlds x 2 targets + join_unanswerable 30 x 2) x 4 rows/shard approx 2,000+ rows
notes.feasibility: measured via plan_variants: K=8 hosts n=4 at L=64 already; 8K target fits L~79, 16K fits L~157, 64K fits L~615 (K=20). All on the feasible surface — infeasible.json should stay empty; any entry is a regression to investigate.
notes.dense_note: dense_aggregate (G72-3, in flight) and research families (G72-4, in flight) register into THIS config in a follow-up commit once their modules land — this wave generates only the families that exist today, then a second invocation with the extended config tops up (fresh seed range 831000+ to avoid world_id collisions).
